steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」：本站會先複製推薦碼 414f2a2c，再開啟 Dori 的分享連結。
steps.en: Select “Sign up”: this site copies referral code 414f2a2c first, then opens the Dori share link.

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面指示下載並開啟 Dori App，請只安裝 App 商店中的官方版本。
steps.en: Follow the page to download and open the Dori app, and install only the official version from the app store.

steps.zh-TW: 在 App 內有輸入好友推薦碼的地方貼上 414f2a2c，或依原樣手動輸入；欄位位置以 App 畫面為準。
steps.en: Where the app asks for a friend referral code, paste 414f2a2c or type it as shown; the field's location follows the app.

intro.zh-TW: Dori 是練習英語口說的 AI 對話 App；分享文案附有推薦碼 414f2a2c。
intro.en: Dori is an AI app for practicing spoken English; the share text carries referral code 414f2a2c.

description.zh-TW:
Dori 是練習英語口說的 AI 對話 App，可免費下載，另有付費訂閱，與 VoiceTube 是同一家公司。本頁連結是分享文案中的 voice.tube 短網址，不含推薦碼：點擊「立即註冊」會先複製推薦碼 414f2a2c，再開啟連結。

App 是否自動帶入未查證，請在 App 內貼上或手動輸入。分享文案沒有提到優惠，不列優惠。實際內容以官方公告為準。
description.en:
Dori is an AI app for practicing spoken English conversation. It is free to download, offers paid subscriptions, and comes from the same company as VoiceTube. The link on this page is the voice.tube short link from the share text and does not carry the referral code: selecting “Sign up” first copies code 414f2a2c and then opens the link.

Whether the app fills in the code by itself was not checked, so paste it in the app or type it in by hand. The share text mentions no offer, so none is listed here. Actual terms follow the official announcements.

notes.zh-TW: 推薦碼 414f2a2c 不在連結網址中，需貼上或手動輸入，請依原樣；App 是否自動帶入未查證。維運者 2026-10-24 開啟短網址，會轉到 applinks.voicetube.com 的 App 連結頁；官方文章（2024）寫輸入位置在 App 的個人頁面，現行畫面未確認，也未註冊測試推薦碼是否被接受。短網址的終點可由擁有者變更，請在繼續前確認最終網址。依 Dori 條款，7 歲以上未滿 20 歲須經法定代理人同意；付費訂閱的內容與費用以 App 為準。heydori.com 的頁尾連到 voicetube.com 與同一個 App Store 頁。
notes.en: Referral code 414f2a2c is not in the link address, so paste it or type it in exactly as shown. Whether the app fills it in automatically was not checked. When the maintainer opened the short link on 2026-10-24, it led to an app-link page on applinks.voicetube.com. An official article (2024) puts the entry field on the app's profile page; the current screen is unconfirmed, and nobody registered to test whether the code is accepted. The destination of a short link can be changed by its owner, so check the final address. Under the Dori terms, ages 7 to under 20 need a legal guardian's consent; subscription terms and fees follow the app. The footer of heydori.com links to voicetube.com and the same App Store listing.

q.zh-TW: Dori 的推薦碼 414f2a2c 要在哪裡輸入？
q.en: Where do I enter Dori referral code 414f2a2c?

a.zh-TW: 本頁連結不含推薦碼，點擊「立即註冊」會先複製它。下載 App 後，請在 App 內輸入好友推薦碼的地方貼上，或依原樣手動輸入。本站未測試推薦碼是否被接受。
a.en: The link on this page does not carry the code, so selecting “Sign up” copies it first. After you install the app, paste it where the app asks for a friend referral code, or type it as shown. This site has not tested whether the code is accepted.

q.zh-TW: 輸入 Dori 推薦碼有優惠嗎？
q.en: Does entering the Dori referral code give an offer?

a.zh-TW: 分享文案沒有提到優惠，本站也無法確認現行的推薦優惠，所以不列優惠。實際內容以 Dori 官方公告與 App 顯示為準。
a.en: The share text mentions no offer, and this site could not confirm a current referral offer, so none is listed. Actual terms follow Dori's official announcements and what the app shows.
